text: {"lessons":["Selling every stock repeatedly just to lock in gains can cut short further upside; I should follow a deliberate plan rather than sell simply because I am ahead.","A string of realized profits does not guarantee a rising account value, so I should evaluate performance across my whole portfolio and over time.","Because past price moves do not predict future changes, I should not treat a falling price as a reason by itself to buy more, or let the pain of a loss dictate whether I sell."]}
